comments.author: Alexander Terp
comments.body: Done without code: the surface reads XTSHIFTESCAPE from the pane's own bytes and the replay restates it; a real-surface test proves it.

creator: Alexander Terp
description: The daemon now reads XTSHIFTESCAPE and reports it on the pane record as Pane.shift_capture (optional bool): true means the program wants shift-clicks reported to it, false means shift-clicks are the surface's to select with, absent means the surface's mouse-shift-capture setting decides. The daemon honors it in its own mouse encoding; the Ghostty surface in the app must honor it too, or a shift-click selects when the program asked for it (or the reverse).
title: The surface honors Pane.shift_capture
